backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a Hindu devotional app, defining types and state for festivals, mantras, aartis, shlokas, temples, community posts, jap counters, dharma quotes, and kathas, with mixins for blob storage and authorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining old and new actor state types and a migration function that updates the kathayen map with new/revised Vrat and Puranik katha entries during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that 10 complete long-form Vrat Kathas in Hindi were added to `frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts` under the vrat category, with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all major frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's React/TypeScript frontend components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/.env.example: Documents that no API key configuration is needed since the Groq AI key is hardcoded in aiEngine.ts, and notes that VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY is no longer used.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file setting up Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a `#root` div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Mandir, Profile, Community, AartiDetail, AdminPanel, AIGuru, Kathayen, KathaDetail) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Reusable card component that renders a linked aarti item with an emoji icon, name, and styled border, navigating to the aarti detail route on click.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main app shell component rendering a sticky devotional header with Om logo and login button, an Outlet for page content, bottom navigation, profile setup modal for new authenticated users, and a footer with Caffeine attribution.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with 7 items (Home, Panchang, Jap, Kathayen, Mandir, AI Guru, Profile) using TanStack Router for navigation, highlighting the active route with gold styling.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Displays a single chat message bubble for either a user or AI role, with avatar, timestamp, and basic markdown rendering (bold and newlines).
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Shows an animated three-dot typing indicator with the AI guru avatar, used to indicate the AI is composing a response.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Fetches and displays a daily dharma quote in Hindi and English with author attribution, falling back to a Bhagavad Gita verse if the API returns nothing.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Displays the next upcoming Hindu festival with a days-remaining countdown and a button to download a shareable festival card generated via HTML Canvas.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders six floating lotus petal images as a fixed decorative background layer with CSS keyframe animations for gentle floating motion.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: A wrapper component that renders a pulsing radial golden glow halo behind its children, with configurable size (numeric or named preset).
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a Katha (story) entry, showing its category badge, deity, title, and a truncated Hindi text preview, styled differently for Puranik vs Vrat categories.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: A loading spinner component that displays a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and an optional text label, in three size variants.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A login/logout button that uses Internet Identity authentication, showing appropriate icons and labels based on the current auth state.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: A full-screen celebratory overlay triggered when a jap count reaches 108, animating a lotus bloom image with petal burst particles and a completion message.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala (prayer bead ring) with 108 beads, filling beads based on a count prop and slowly rotating the ring with a central Om symbol.
Displays a short-lived particle burst animation of three Om symbols radiating outward, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/PremiumBanner.ts: Shows a dismissible promotional banner for 'Sanatan Pro Premium' listing four benefits and an upgrade CTA button, persisting dismissal state in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name and saves a UserProfile (with a default mantra) via a mutation hook, blocking dismissal until complete.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders up to four concentric ripple ring animations triggered by a numeric prop, each burst consisting of three expanding and fading circles.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Sanskrit shloka with Hindi and English meanings, providing copy, share, and canvas-based image download functionality.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A fasting/vrat dashboard showing Brahma Muhurat time, a daily fasting check-in button, countdown timers to Ekadashi and Shivratri, and a Navratri day progress tracker stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A simple toggle switch component to enable or disable Vrat Mode, with a styled border that highlights when active.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: Custom React hook managing an AI chat session, including message state, sending messages with conversation history, error handling, and chat clearing functionality using the aiEngine library.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, jap counter, dharma quotes, festivals, mantras, kathas, and user management.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Custom React hook wrapping the Web Speech API to play, pause, resume, and stop text-to-speech narration with Hindi voice support and graceful fallback handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light/dark themes with devotional color tokens (saffron, gold, maroon), Tailwind imports, font families, and keyframe animations for devotional UI effects.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Implements a local spiritual AI response system with keyword-based matching that returns Hindi spiritual guidance responses, with optional Groq API enhancement. Contains predefined response banks for topics like meditation, mantras, dharma, Krishna, Shiva, and yoga.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for a Hindu astrology/horoscope feature, including all 12 zodiac signs (rashis) with metadata and templated daily prediction content for love and career aspects.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Provides static Katha (religious story) data including full Hindi texts of Ramayan and Mahabharat with all major chapters, typed against the backend's Katha interface with approval status and metadata.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Implements accurate Hindu Panchang (calendar) calculations using astronomical algorithms from Jean Meeus, computing sun/moon positions, Julian Day Numbers, and related calendar data for IST timezone centered on Central India.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Contains static data for Hindu religious content including Sanskrit shlokas with Hindi/English meanings and full Aarti texts (Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu) in both Hindi and transliterated English.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that bootstraps the app with React Query, Internet Identity authentication provider, and mounts the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single aarti fetched by ID from static data, supporting Hindi/English toggle, copy-to-clipboard, and native share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only panel (guarded by Internet Identity and admin role check) with tabs for approving/rejecting users, assigning roles, and adding dharma quotes.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: A full-screen AI chat page featuring a Hindi spiritual assistant with suggested questions, auto-resizing textarea input, scroll-to-bottom button, and typing indicator.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community feed page showing seed posts with like/report actions, a compose dialog for new posts, and an approval-request flow gated by Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Authenticated dashboard page that redirects unauthenticated users to home, shows a welcome message with the user's profile name, and triggers a profile setup modal when no profile exists.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home page displaying a hero section with greeting, diya animation, today's panchang data, a dharma quote, featured aartis, and upcoming festivals fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Jap (mantra chanting) page that lets users tap to count mantra repetitions on a mala, tracks session and lifetime counts, syncs to the backend for authenticated users, and shows animated ripple/particle/lotus effects on milestones.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail view for a single katha (sacred story), fetching data from the backend with a static fallback, supporting Hindi/English language toggle, and providing text-to-speech narration via the useSpeechNarration hook.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Kathayen listing page that displays all sacred stories with category tabs (Puranik, Krishna Leela, Vrat) and a search filter, using backend data with a static fallback.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Mandir (temple finder) page that shows a Google Maps link to find nearby Hindu temples and lists famous temples with details and live darshan/directions buttons.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Panchang (Hindu almanac) page that displays daily astronomical and calendar data (tithi, nakshatra, sunrise/sunset, etc.) for a user-selected date and lists upcoming festivals fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: React page for user profile management, allowing authenticated and guest users to select a mantra (saved to backend or localStorage) and view stats. Includes logout functionality and a loading state via Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist values in sessionStorage and clean sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream), custom fonts (Yatra One, Poppins, Tiro Devanagari Hindi), and divine glow box shadows.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for 'Divya Darshan' app, documenting existing features, known issues, and pending feature requests including adding 10 long Vrat Kathas with Hindi text, audio narration controls, and backend seeding.
